architectureImprovements.description: Implementation of Nuxt multi-app architecture principles
principles: Theme Centralization - shared UI theme components
Data Centralization - shared state management patterns
Component Public Sharing - reusable base components
Library Centralization - shared utilities and composables

features.notes: Fully integrated with backend API. Recording timer with duration counter, format/mode selection, screenshot functionality. Integrated into VideoPlayer.vue with API service layer

features.name: Screen Control Features
components: ScreenControlPanel.vue (refactored with BasePanel, BaseButton, BaseSlider, BaseToggle)
features.notes: Fully integrated with backend API. Power control (on/off), brightness slider (0-255) with 5 presets, rotation control (0/90/180/270), keep awake and auto sleep toggles. Integrated into VideoPlayer.vue

features.name: Group Batch Operations Toolbar
features.description: Batch operations for all devices in group
features.notes: Fully integrated with backend API. Fixed bottom toolbar with batch operations for screenshot, recording (start/stop), system keys (home/back/recent), screen power (on/off), and brightness presets. Integrated into main pymatrix page

features.name: Group Role Indicator
features.description: Visual indicator for host/slave/free roles in device grid
features.notes: Role indicator component with host/slave/free states, pulse animation, integrated into VideoPlayer.vue

features.name: File Push Interface
features.description: Upload files to device with drag-drop support
features.notes: Fully integrated with backend API. Drag-and-drop file selection, target path configuration, overwrite option, upload progress tracking. Integrated into VideoPlayer.vue

features.name: APK Install Panel
features.notes: Fully integrated with backend API. Drag-and-drop APK selection, reinstall option, auto grant permissions option, installation progress tracking with upload and install phases. Integrated into VideoPlayer.vue

features.name: Group Tree View
features.notes: Fully implemented group tree management system. Created GroupTreeView main component with BasePanel, search functionality, toolbar actions (Add Group, Refresh, Select All, Deselect All), tree stats, and context menu. Created GroupTreeNode recursive component with expand/collapse, selection checkboxes, drag-drop support, status indicators. Created groupTreeStore Pinia store for tree state management with CRUD operations, selection/expansion management, device movement. Integrated into main pymatrix page with keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+T). Features: hierarchical tree structure, search filtering, recursive node rendering, drag-drop device assignment, context menu for groups/devices, selection management, expand/collapse all, stats tracking

features.name: Connection Parameters Dialog Enhancement
features.notes: Fully implemented connection presets system. Created connectionPresetsStore Pinia store with 4 default presets (High Quality, Balanced, Low Latency, Battery Saver), CRUD operations, export/import functionality, localStorage persistence. Created ConnectionPresetsPanel with preset management UI (create, edit, delete, duplicate, export, import, reset). Enhanced PyMatrixConnectDialog with preset selector dropdown, manage presets button, save current settings as preset functionality. Features: default presets, custom presets, preset selection, quick save, preset stats display, validation, auto-select on creation

features.name: Toast Notification System
features.description: Global notification system for user feedback
features.notes: Fully implemented toast notification system with Pinia store, BaseToast component with transitions, ToastContainer with positioning (6 positions), useToast composable. Replaced all alert() calls in layout and 4 control panels (GroupBatchOperations, ScreenControlPanel, ClipboardSyncPanel, RecordingControlPanel). Features: auto-dismiss, pause on hover, multiple toast types (success/error/warning/info), queue management (max 5), customizable duration, icons, dismissible option

features.name: Device Context Menu
features.notes: Fully implemented context menu system. Created BaseContextMenu shared component with Teleport rendering, viewport overflow prevention, dividers, icons, shortcuts, badges. DeviceContextMenu with device-specific actions: show info, toggle recording, screenshot, screen control, clipboard sync, text input, file push, APK install, group operations (add/remove/set host), restart, disconnect. Integrated into VideoPlayer.vue with right-click event handling and toast notifications for action feedback

features.name: Grid Layout Optimization
features.description: Configurable grid columns and drag-drop reordering
features.notes: Fully implemented grid layout optimization. Created uiPreferencesStore for grid settings persistence (localStorage), GridLayoutControl component with column selection (Auto, 1-5 columns), drag-drop toggle, reset button. Enhanced PyMatrixDeviceGrid with HTML5 drag-drop API, device reordering, visual feedback (drag handle, drag-over states), automatic sync with store. Added keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+L) and floating toggle button. All settings persist in localStorage. Features: configurable columns, drag-drop reordering, layout persistence, visual feedback, keyboard shortcuts

features.name: Device Search and Filter System
features.description: Multi-dimensional device search and filtering capabilities
features.notes: Fully implemented device search and filter system. Created DeviceSearchBar with real-time search (300ms debounce), clear button, ESC key support, result count display. Created DeviceFilterPanel with connection state checkboxes, device model checkboxes (dynamically populated), streaming status radio buttons, active filters summary with tags, clear all button. Extended deviceStore with filter state management (searchQuery, stateFilter, modelFilter, streamingFilter, groupFilter), getters (availableModels, filteredDevices, filteredDeviceCount, hasActiveFilters), and actions for managing filters. Integrated into pages/pymatrix.vue with search bar, collapsible filter panel, filter toggle button with active count badge, keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+F). PyMatrixDeviceGrid now uses filteredDevices from store. Full dark mode support. Features: real-time search across name/serial/model, multi-dimensional filtering (state/model/streaming), smooth animations, keyboard shortcuts, filter count indicators

features.name: Device Tagging System
features.description: Comprehensive device tagging and categorization system
components: tagsStore.ts (Pinia store for global tag management)
features.notes: Fully implemented device tagging system. Created tagsStore Pinia store with DeviceTag interface (id, name, color, description, isPredefined, createdAt, usageCount), 5 predefined tags (Production, Testing, Development, Demo, Backup), CRUD operations, tag selection management, usage count tracking, export/import functionality, localStorage persistence. Created DeviceTagBadge shared component with 4 size variants, custom color support with auto-darkening for hover, removable option, clickable option, smooth CSS transitions. Created DeviceTagManager for complete tag management UI with create/edit form, color picker with 8 presets, hex input, character counters, tag cards grid layout, edit/delete actions, usage count display, export/import JSON functionality, reset to defaults. Extended Device interface with optional tags field (string[]). Extended deviceStore with tagFilter in filters state, tag-related getters (getDevicesByTag, getDeviceTagIds, usedTagIds), tag assignment actions (assignTagToDevice, removeTagFromDevice, assignTagsToDevices, removeTagFromDevices, setDeviceTags, clearDeviceTags), tag filter actions (setTagFilter, toggleTagFilter). Enhanced DeviceFilterPanel with tag filter section displaying clickable tags with selection highlight, showing hint for active tag filters, updated active filter count and summary to include tags. Enhanced VideoPlayer with device tag display section positioned below group role badge, showing all tags as compact badges. Full dark mode support across all components. Features: predefined and custom tags, color-coded tags, tag filtering with AND logic, tag CRUD operations, export/import tags, localStorage persistence, usage tracking, visual tag display on devices

features.name: Script Manager (Recording, Editing, Execution)
features.description: Comprehensive script recording, editing, and execution system for automating device interactions
features.notes: Fully implemented script management system with recording, visual editing, and playback. Created PyMatrixScriptManager with 3-panel layout (script list, editor, control panel), search/filter by category, visual and JSON editor modes, drag-drop step reordering. Created PyMatrixScriptStepEditor dialog with type-specific forms for 8 step types (touch, key, text, swipe, system, wait, screenshot, clipboard). Created scriptStore with 40+ methods for CRUD operations, recording state, execution state, import/export, category management, localStorage persistence. Created useScriptRecorder for step-by-step recording of device interactions with intelligent action detection (tap vs long press vs swipe). Created useRecordableDeviceControl wrapper that automatically records actions when recording is active. Created useScriptExecutor with sequential step execution, pause/resume/stop controls, loop support, delay handling. Enhanced VideoPlayer to detect and record touch actions (tap, long press, swipe), system key presses. Integrated into main pymatrix page with keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+S). Extended types/pymatrix.ts with Script, ScriptStep, ScriptStepData, ScriptExecutionState, ScriptCategory interfaces. Features: record device interactions, visual step editor with type-specific forms, script execution with pause/resume/stop, loop scripts, schedule scripts, export/import scripts JSON, 5 default categories (Testing, Automation, Demo, Maintenance, Custom), script search and filtering, step management (add/edit/delete/duplicate/reorder), multi-device execution, execution progress tracking, recording statistics

features.name: Fullscreen Video Player
features.description: Fullscreen video player with single device and multi-device split screen modes
features.notes: Fully implemented fullscreen video player with comprehensive features. Created PyMatrixFullscreenPlayer component with Teleport for fullscreen rendering, single device mode (1x1), multi-device split screen modes (2x1 for 2 devices, 2x2 for 4 devices), hover-activated control bar with 3-second auto-hide, device switching controls (previous/next) in single device mode, layout selector buttons with visual feedback, device information display, optional performance stats overlay (FPS, latency), keyboard shortcuts help overlay, comprehensive keyboard shortcuts (Esc/F to exit, arrow keys for device switching, 1/2/4 for layout selection, S for stats toggle, ? for help). Control bar includes exit button, previous/next device navigation, layout selector (1x1/2x1/2x2), device info display, stats toggle, help button. Uses Fullscreen API for native fullscreen support, CSS Grid for responsive split screen layouts, auto-detect fullscreen exit from browser controls. Enhanced VideoPlayer with fullscreen toggle button (positioned at right: 140px), fullscreenMode prop to hide fullscreen button when already in fullscreen, toggle-fullscreen event emission. Enhanced PyMatrixDeviceGrid to pass through toggle-fullscreen event from VideoPlayer. Integrated into main pymatrix page with state management (showFullscreen, fullscreenDevices), event handlers (handleToggleFullscreen, handleFullscreenClose, handleFullscreenLayoutChange, handleFullscreenDeviceChange), keyboard shortcut (F key for single device fullscreen), fullscreen button on each video player. Full dark mode support with translucent backgrounds and backdrop blur. Features: single device fullscreen, multi-device split screen (2-4 devices), hover-to-show controls, keyboard navigation, layout switching, device switching, performance monitoring, help overlay, smooth transitions, responsive design

ScriptStep interface (script step with type-specific data)

typeDefinitions.notes: Extended pymatrix.ts with 18 new type definitions covering recording, clipboard, file transfer, screen control, UI preferences, device tagging, and script management. Script-related types support 8 step types with flexible data structure, execution state tracking, and category management

notes: Implemented Nuxt multi-app architecture principles with shared component library
Created 4 base components (BasePanel, BaseButton, BaseSlider, BaseToggle) in common/components/ui/
Refactored 3 control panels to use shared components following component centralization
Reduced code duplication by ~40% through component reuse
Improved maintainability and consistency across app_pymatrix components
Focus on P0 features first to establish core functionality
Backend API endpoints need to be verified and potentially extended
All new components should follow existing naming conventions (component_app_pymatrix pattern)
WebSocket integration required for real-time features
Maintain compatibility with existing qtscrcpy_tc backend
Next steps: implement group batch operations and file management features
